about_short_description.short_description: Avallon Labs automates insurance claims operations with AI agents that handle calls and data entry to streamline adjuster workflows.

product.name: Auto Workers Comp Claim Intaker
product.description: An AI agent that captures new loss claims via phone, email, or file upload and files First Notice of Loss (FNOL) without manual data entry.

product.name: Coverage & Liability Copilot
product.description: An AI tool that analyzes policy terms, compares facts, and flags exposures to assist adjusters in faster decision-making.

product.name: Repairshop Liason
product.description: An AI agent that contacts repair shops for status updates, logs information, and synchronizes updates to the claim file.

product.name: Subrogation Specialist
product.description: An AI agent that manages the subrogation process end-to-end, including contacting carriers, tracking responses, and filing necessary paperwork.

product.name: Context-Aware AI
product.description: An AI system that understands claims workflows and data end-to-end to guide real-time decision-making.

product.name: Dialer
product.description: A system that manages inbound and outbound calls, extracts key details, and shares case updates within claims operations.
